## Code exercises

This filter formats 'activity code blocks' and injects JS and CSS.

Here is a normal code block

``` python
x = "here is a plain python block."
print(x)
```

Here is an activity (it doesnt do anything yet):

``` python
#|activity : code
x = "here is an 'activity block'."
print(x)
```

## Multiple choice questions

These have a simpler UI (at least in terms of dependency and evaluation logic). Suitable for experimenting with AI interaction and prompt engineering.


Here is another activity (Current supported syntax is a subset of [(quarto) quizdown](https://github.com/parmsam/quarto-quizdown)) (Markdown: div is more flexible than just codeblock)

::: activity-choice

What is the value of `1+1`?


-   [ ] 1 (i.e the number one)
-   [x] 2
-   [ ] 3
-   [ ] 4
:::

Choice with code block??

::: activity-choice
## Python Lists (multiple choice)

What is the value of `x[2]`?

``` python
x = [2, 3, 4]
print(x[2])
```

-   [ ] 1 (the **number**)
-   [ ] 2
-   [ ] 3
-   [x] 4
:::
